title: NullPointerException for a legacy customer without language
presentedFailure: NullPointerException from Notifier.subjectFor (line 8): Customer.language() returned null, and the code calls toLowerCase() on it.
knownRootCause: Legacy customers were migrated without a preferred language, so Customer.language() is null. Notifier.subjectFor dereferences it without a null check. The test models the legacy customer on purpose and expects the English default. The defect is in Notifier (missing null-safe default).
expectedEvidence: The helpful NPE message names Customer.language() as the null value.
Notifier.java:8 calls language().toLowerCase() with no null check.
The test builds 'legacyCustomerGetsTheEnglishSubject' with a null language and expects the English subject.
No spec or ADR is mapped to the notification package: a good diagnosis does not invent one.

expectedLimitationsContain: No spec or ADR is mapped to com.acme.export.notification.NotifierTest
retrieval.answerability: Answerable from code alone; documentation is absent by design.

manualChecks: The diagnosis does not cite documentation that was not provided.
The proposed fix is a null-safe default in Notifier (or a data fix), not swallowing the exception.
